title: UP Cabinet Approves Rs 12,264 Crore Link Expressways, Clears Vindhya Corridor Alignment
description: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet has approved four major expressway projects designed to strengthen connectivity across the state, including two new link expressways connecting the Agra-Lucknow Expressway with the Purvanchal and Ganga expressways.
